PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.py ]]; then black --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; ruff check --fix --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi'
PostToolUse.description: Auto-format Python files with black + ruff after edits

PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.env* ]]; then echo "BLOCKED: Refusing to edit .env files — add secrets manually"; exit 1; fi; if [[ "$FILE" == */vendor/* ]]; then echo "BLOCKED: vendor/ is a git submodule — do not edit"; exit 1; fi'
PreToolUse.description: Block edits to .env files and vendor/ directory
